remarks: Charming Ground-Level Rental in West Norwalk Located at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this inviting ground-level unit in a high ranch home offers a comfortable living space in a serene setting. The open floor plan includes a cozy living room and an updated kitchenette. The spacious bedroom features ample closet space, and the bathroom has double vanity sinks and an in-unit laundry for added convenience. Enjoy the proximity to shopping, top-rated restaurants, and beautiful beaches, with easy access to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Commuting to NYC is a breeze via the nearby Darien train station. Electricity is included in the rent. One pet under 16 lbs is welcome!
